authHint.label: Zoom OAuth
authHint.helpText: Create a User-managed General App in the Zoom App Marketplace, add this deployment's redirect URI (HTTPS; Zoom rejects localhost), add the scopes listed above, and paste that app's client ID and secret — Zoom does not support dynamic client registration.
